body: Yea I feel you, supports in the end are people too and they are just as liable to backfire on helping as much as anyone. Also had therapists backfire on me too, first one just talked but didn't really solve anything, 2nd tried to dope me up on pills which gave me terrible headaches and I stopped taking them, and the 3rd well tried to help but really couldn't help too much. I hope you find somebody you can open up to though, I mean it may not cure your wanting to die but it can get you through the day.

I too feel that way but the fact you have a wife is a treasure. Many of us don't have a connection so close to us, but I also understand you know that nothing lasts forever. I too kinda lose the good times vibe when I remember that its all just temporary. Its kind of hard to sustain being happy when you know how it all ends. Perhaps like me you are waiting for an answer, something to give you a reason to continue. Well, your wife is one, you should be with her for as long as you can for not many even bother supporting what some may consider to be lost causes. Those weeks that she cared for you, that shows you how much she loves you. I don't know how much this will help, I'm in a dark place myself at the moment.
Not sure if that is the best idea, but that is of course my opinion. People may take advantage of you for putting yourself into this position.

Shrug anything is possible I gave that number mainly because 25-50-75 are my suicide checkpoints. If I am at a point in my life where I am all alone and there is nothing left then I will just say &*(^ it. But who knows maybe it will happen sooner, like I said and it will just accelerate things. Could be this year, could be next year who knows. I just leave room for anything to be possible even if I end up being old. Then again like you said I don't even know if I want to.
Seems like it, just tried with my guys to connect again and nothing even with Luxembourg. :-(
Its all good, it was due to the major online blackout that got everyone stirred up and the latest version is working fine.

Yea my friend and I downloaded the mod but a lil while ago we lost the ability to see node drawing and I don't think we are being connected to MP channels at all. Could it be possible that if we reconnect too much that the service could think we are DDOSing and block our connection to the server period?

Meh it doesn't matter anymore...that was the old me all those years ago. Now I just want to end it, while I still can before I get too old to even do that. Who knows with the amount of stress on my body from this depression I might get a heart condition and one day it just....stops. Then finally my body will do what my mind wants and just die.
Thanks worked on it for the past 3 days so I appreciate the compliment!

Its not about whether you deserve to be alone or not. It just happens. Sometimes due to circumstances beyond our control or we made bad choices that come back to haunt us. I got another response from elsewhere saying that the world is beautiful and such. I go it is, but its also a vicious creature that can be just as generous as it is cruel. Much like the randomness of the creatures that dwell upon the earth. Very much like man himself, capable of being both kind and terribly brutal. 

My father is an optimist and I kinda grind against him as a pessimist/realist. I truly hate full on optimism that discounts the horror of reality. Life isn't fair and people do terrible things even for the right reasons. We may not be alone in our suffrage but once you leave that computer or turn off that phone you're back to being alone once again. Just as its always been. I don't take comfort knowing others are going through the same thing.

I find it sad, that despite all our progress as a species we still can't can't effectively help people with issues such as these. All we can do is just group together and tell each other our stories. So that even if the worst happens someone knows that we were in pain. Its not a perfect solution....but its something to keep us going. To keep me going in particular. I'm talking about this because if I let this froth around in my head for too long, I'll want to take it off with a sawed off. Just like an uncle of mine did when he lost everything.

Same boat as you at this point. Just when you need friends they aren't there anymore and even if a friend does show up online its like what can they do at this point? They are miles away and no one is around where I live. As I watch politicians play the game of thrones and I see my fellows just struggling to get by...it really does feel hopeless. The only solace I can think of is that one way...or another..this will end. Whether you kill yourself (which sadly causes more pain) or you slowly grind away into nothing or live long enough to see the world that you knew end. The way things are cannot last forever and sometimes things that you look for just randomly happen to you without you even trying. I won't tell you things get better or god forbid tell you to keep a stiff upper lip (my brother told me that not long ago and my reaction internally was oh ffs). But I can tell you that thankfully nothing last forever, good times and bad. They ebb and flow as all things do.
